title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts Benefits Beyond the Repair — Rental, Towing, Trip Interruption, Roadside
content:
**General condition.** Under a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, benefits beyond the repair are paid only together with a covered component repair under the same claim number.

**(a) Rental.** Rental is reimbursed at the coverage level's rental amount per day for each calendar day the vehicle is at the store for the covered repair. The days run from the day the repair order is opened to the day the repair is completed. No more than the level's most rental days per claim are paid, counting the rental days already paid on the claim. A courtesy loaner the store provides free of charge is not reimbursed.

**(b) Towing.** Towing to the nearest authorized repair facility is paid up to the level's towing amount per breakdown.

**(c) Trip interruption.** Where the breakdown happens at least the level's trip-interruption distance from the holder's home ZIP, lodging and meals are paid. Payment is up to the level's trip-interruption amount per day, for at most the level's most trip-interruption days.

**(d) Benefits a level does not carry.** A benefit whose per-day amount or day limit is 0 is not part of the coverage level. A request for it is denied with the reason component not covered.

**(e) Roadside.** Where the level includes roadside assistance, jump starts, lockouts, fuel delivery and flat-tire changes are arranged through the 24-hour roadside line at no charge.

**(f) No deductible.** No deductible is taken on rental, towing or trip-interruption lines.

**Status of clause (a).** Clause (a) is **no longer in force** for a rental line priced under the rental benefit rule that applies to the claim of the contract's latest component-repair line where the first loaner agreement for its repair order is a Kessler loaner on which the holder was charged daily rental. Such a line takes its days and daily amount under its own rule. Every rental that rule does not price is still reimbursed as clause (a) reads, including:
- a rental on any other claim;
- a rental under a loaner agreement other than the first one listed for the repair order;
- a loaner the holder was not charged for;
- a rental from outside the group.

**Worked figures (hypothetical).**
- **Trip interruption.** At a level paying 120.00 a day for at most 4 days, a breakdown 230 miles from home with 6 nights away pays 120.00 times 4, which is 480.00.
- **Distance boundary.** A breakdown at exactly the level's distance qualifies. One mile nearer does not.
- **Clause (a) rental.** A vehicle at the store from the 3rd to the 9th of a month, at a level paying 30.00 a day for at most 5 days per claim, with nothing yet paid on the claim: 7 calendar days at the store, capped at 5, gives 150.00.

superseded_clauses: Rental is reimbursed at rental_per_day_usd per calendar day the vehicle is at the store for the covered repair, from the day the repair order is opened to the day the repair is completed, up to rental_max_days_per_claim days per claim (vsc_msr_rental_days_paid_on_claim); a courtesy loaner the store provides free of charge is not reimbursed.
